plain: The chance that the judge scores a random real YES item above a random real NO item.
eli5: Pick one good apple and one bad apple; how often does the judge give the good one the higher mark?
technical: Area under the ROC curve; equals the Mann–Whitney probability P(score<sub>YES</sub> > score<sub>NO</sub>) with ties counted half (Hanley and McNeil 1982). Threshold-free and blind to calibration.
